outcomes: A service persists and queries typed records through a pool-bound repository
Related writes on one datasource commit together or roll back together
A request-scoped unit of work transparently shares one transaction per participating datasource
Transaction telemetry explains the boundary without disclosing query parameters, row data, or panic values
The goroutines serving one request query through its unit of work at once without breaking its transaction, and can read in parallel outside it
nonGoals: Providing distributed atomic commit across multiple datasources
Hiding PostgreSQL behavior behind a database-independent ORM
Defining migration command behavior owned by go.putnami.dev/migration and go.putnami.dev/migratecli

requirements.text: A transaction is keyed by the pool that began it; nested work on the same pool reuses it and a different pool never receives that transaction.
When WithTx owns a transaction, it commits after a nil callback result, rolls back after an error or panic, releases the connection after failed commit, and never double-finalizes the transaction.

text: A request unit of work begins at most one transaction per enrolled pool and finalizes every owned transaction once at the request boundary, including after cancellation and rollback-only outcomes;
WithTx inside that request joins the enrolled transaction without taking finalization ownership.

requirements.text: Multi-datasource commit is deterministic best-effort rather than two-phase commit; a failure reports the committed prefix and rolls back every uncommitted remainder.
Rollback telemetry uses only fixed outcome classifications and never emits raw error text, bound parameters, row data, or panic values.

Queries that the goroutines of one request send on a unit-of-work transaction run one at a time on its connection: each holds the transaction until its result is closed, a query waiting for its turn ends with its own context, and the request boundary refuses later queries and closes a result the request left open before it finalizes the transaction.

text: A query on a context marked Autocommit runs on its own pooled connection, outside the request unit of work and every WithTx transaction the context carries;
WithTx under such a context begins and owns its own transaction.
